title: Kerala Pravasi Sangham announces Statewide agitation against government’s ‘anti-expatriate policies’

ai.summary: Kerala Pravasi Sangham announced statewide protests against UDF government's alleged anti-expatriate policies, including pension arrears and health insurance scheme issues, with planned marches and a 48-hour satyagraha.

facts.claim: Kerala Pravasi Sangham announced a series of strong Statewide protests against what it terms the anti-expatriate policies of the United Democratic Front (UDF) government.
facts.quote: The Kerala Pravasi Sangham has announced a series of strong Statewide protests against what it terms the anti-expatriate policies of the United Democratic Front (UDF) government.

facts.claim: The agitation is aimed at protesting the budgetary neglect of expatriate welfare schemes, pending expatriate pension arrears, and the continued disregard for the welfare board.
facts.quote: Addressing a press meet here on Tuesday, organisation leaders stated that the agitation is aimed at protesting the budgetary neglect of expatriate welfare schemes, pending expatriate pension arrears, and the continued disregard for the welfare board.

facts.claim: They further accused the government of pushing the pension scheme into crisis by withholding financial assistance, disbanding the Loka Kerala Sabha, and attempting to dismantle the NoRKA Care health insurance scheme.
facts.quote: They further accused the government of pushing the pension scheme into crisis by withholding financial assistance, disbanding the Loka Kerala Sabha, and attempting to dismantle the NoRKA Care health insurance scheme.

facts.claim: The organisation pointed out that by doubling and tripling the premium for the NoRKA Care insurance scheme, the government is jeopardising the survival of a vital health security initiative meant to support nearly five lakh expatriate families.
facts.quote: The organisation pointed out that by doubling and tripling the premium for the NoRKA Care insurance scheme, the government is jeopardising the survival of a vital health security initiative meant to support nearly five lakh expatriate families.

facts.claim: As part of the agitation, expatriates from all areas across the district will stage a march to the Kollam Collectorate on November 19.
facts.quote: As part of the agitation, expatriates from all areas across the district will stage a march to the Kollam Collectorate on November 19.

facts.claim: Following this, a 48-hour satyagraha will be organised in front of the Secretariat in Thiruvananthapuram on November 27 and 28, during which 10 lakh collected signatures will be submitted to the Chief Minister.
facts.quote: Following this, a 48-hour satyagraha will be organised in front of the Secretariat in Thiruvananthapuram on November 27 and 28, during which 10 lakh collected signatures will be submitted to the Chief Minister.

ai.background_note: Kerala Pravasi Sangham is a state-level organisation that represents expatriates in Kerala, and this protest is part of their ongoing campaign against government policies affecting expatriate welfare.
